title: Our Future Health — Participant geographies data — LSOA
description: Array of Our Future Health participant geography records. One element is one participant living in England or Wales: their Lower Super Output Area (LSOA) at the time of registration.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce that ID is unique across rows, or that every PID exists in the participant table (D090). Whether a geography code is one of the source's listed codes is not checked (D098).
